wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.description: A wild wolf - requires taming but becomes fiercely loyal
wolf.notes: Wild wolves can resist or attack during an untamed approach. Once bonded, a healthy wolf following you helps without loyalty penalties and will not flee or attack its owner.

raven.name: Raven
raven.description: An intelligent raven with an independent nature and a helpful bond
raven.notes: Keeps its independent nature. Once bonded, a healthy raven following you contributes its help without a loyalty threshold.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: A stealthy cat with an independent nature and a helpful bond
cat.notes: Cats keep their own personalities. A healthy bonded cat following you still contributes its help without loyalty penalties.

owl.name: Owl
owl.description: A wise owl - naturally loyal and eager to bond
owl.notes: Bonds quickly and stays loyal. A reliable companion.

fox.name: Fox
fox.description: A cunning fox - playful but does its own thing
fox.notes: Clever and tricky in the wild. A bonded fox remains protected and contributes its help while healthy and following you.

bear_cub.name: Bear Cub
bear_cub.description: A wild bear cub - an untamed approach can be dangerous
bear_cub.notes: An untamed cub or its nearby mother can attack during an approach. Once bonded, the cub will not attack its owner or flee because of low loyalty.

hawk.name: Hawk
hawk.description: A majestic hawk - bonds through hunting together
hawk.notes: Proud but loyal. Hunts by your side willingly.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.description: A timid rabbit - a gentle companion that benefits from food and care
rabbit.notes: A bonded rabbit may be injured while helping, but remains in the family even at zero HP. Food heals it so it can help again; it does not die or flee.

snake.name: Snake
snake.description: A venomous snake - dangerous during an untamed approach
snake.notes: An untamed snake may attack or poison you during an approach. Once bonded, it will not turn on its owner because of low loyalty.

squirrel.name: Squirrel
squirrel.description: An adorable squirrel - fragile but finds treasure!
squirrel.notes: A shy treasure finder. A bonded squirrel may need food after an injury, but stays in the family and will not flee because its owner was hurt.

bat.name: Bat
bat.description: A cave-dwelling bat - sees in darkness and finds hidden treasures
bat.notes: Thrives in darkness. May be startled by bright lights.

wild_horse.name: Wild Horse
wild_horse.description: A majestic wild mustang - proud, fast, and fiercely independent
wild_horse.notes: Wild mustangs respond to patient, gentle approaches. Once bonded, they remain in the family; their independent nature does not cause loyalty penalties.

coyote_pup.name: Coyote Pup
coyote_pup.description: A young coyote - clever and mischievous, bonds through play
coyote_pup.notes: Playful and clever. A bonded pup benefits from food and care, and helps while healthy and following you without loyalty penalties.

maintenance_droid.name: Maintenance Droid
maintenance_droid.description: A small, helpful repair bot - eager to assist and surprisingly loyal
maintenance_droid.notes: Beeps happily when it helps. Loves collecting spare parts.

scrap_spider.name: Scrap Spider
scrap_spider.description: A mechanical arachnid built from salvage - creepy but incredibly useful
scrap_spider.notes: Skitters into hard-to-reach places. Some people find it unsettling.

direwolf.name: Direwolf
direwolf.description: A LEGENDARY alpha predator - formidable in the wild and a powerful bonded companion
direwolf.notes: ⚠️ SECRET COMPANION: Can only be obtained through special means.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: A LEGENDARY phoenix - chooses its master, bonds deeply
phoenix.notes: ⚠️ SECRET COMPANION: The phoenix chooses its master. Can only be obtained through special means.

service_droid.name: Service Droid
service_droid.description: A crafted companion; activate it from your bag to have it follow and help.

combat_droid.name: Combat Droid
combat_droid.description: A crafted companion; activate it from your bag to have it follow and help.

repair_bot.name: Repair Bot
repair_bot.description: A crafted companion; activate it from your bag to have it follow and help.

medical_drone.name: Medical Assistance Drone
medical_drone.description: A crafted companion; activate it from your bag to have it follow and help.

messenger.name: Messenger
messenger.description: Can deliver messages to other players

nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
nine_lives.description: Small chance to avoid fatal damage once per day

eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
eagle_eye.description: Spot items and enemies from great distances

dive_attack.name: Dive Attack
dive_attack.description: First attack in combat gets bonus

echolocation.name: Echolocation
echolocation.description: Can detect hidden objects and creatures in darkness

tech_scanner.name: Tech Scanner
tech_scanner.description: Better chance to find tech components when gathering

self_repair.name: Self Repair
self_repair.description: Slowly repairs itself over time, reducing maintenance

wall_crawl.name: Wall Crawl
wall_crawl.description: Can reach places others cannot - bonus to finding hidden items

salvage_instinct.name: Salvage Instinct
salvage_instinct.description: Automatically identifies valuable scrap from junk

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.description: Once per week, revive from death

fire_aura.name: Fire Aura
fire_aura.description: Deals fire damage to nearby enemies

inspiring_presence.name: Inspiring Presence
inspiring_presence.description: Allies gain bonus to all rolls

swift_travel.name: Swift Travel
swift_travel.description: Faster travel between locations, reduced cooldowns on travel

sure_footed.name: Sure-Footed
sure_footed.description: Never stumbles - immune to terrain penalties

wild_spirit.name: Wild Spirit
wild_spirit.description: Cannot be fully broken - gains loyalty faster in wilderness areas

night_hunter.name: Night Hunter
night_hunter.description: Bonus to hunting at night or in dark areas

slot_unlock_methods.slot_5: Complete 50 quests OR tame a legendary companion

companion_rules.note: You can have multiple companions but only one following companion contributes assistance at a time.
companion_rules.loyalty_system: Loyalty records use and care. Bonded companions have no passive loyalty decay, loyalty penalties, or owner-directed attacks and fleeing.
companion_rules.feeding: Food heals animal companions; spare parts repair robots. An injured companion remains owned and rests from helping at zero HP.

aggressive.description: Bold animals that can be dangerous before they bond
traits: Starts with very low loyalty (10-25%)
Untamed approaches can cause attacks or escape according to the species
Bonded followers provide their positive bonuses without loyalty penalties
Strong hunting and combat help once bonded
Wild approach risk ends when the companion joins the family

independent.description: Keeps its own personality while sharing a helpful bond
traits: Starts with medium loyalty (45-55%)
Independent behavior is personality, not a chance to withhold owned-companion bonuses
No loyalty penalties for bonded followers
Configured help applies while healthy and following
Low maintenance

loyal.description: Naturally wants to bond - reliable and eager
traits: Starts with high loyalty (65-90%)
No loyalty penalties for bonded followers
Consistent bonuses
Easy to maintain
Best for beginners

timid.description: Shy companions that welcome gentle food and care
traits: Starts with high loyalty (75-80%) - they trust you!
Injured followers remain owned and recoverable, even at zero HP
Timid behavior is personality, not a reason to lose the companion
Minor bonuses but special abilities (luck, gathering)
Food heals injuries; being away causes no passive decline

loyalty_mechanics.loyalty_requirement: Imported species threshold retained for compatibility; bonded hunting, taming and combat help does not require crossing it.
loyalty_mechanics.bonuses_vs_penalties: Commons uses the positive bonuses of a healthy following companion and applies no loyalty penalties. An injured companion rests from helping until healed or repaired.

wolf.taming_tip: Approach slowly with food. Wolves respect strength.

raven.taming_tip: Ravens are curious. Offer something shiny.

cat.taming_tip: Cats choose you, not the other way around.

owl.taming_tip: Owls bond through patience and respect.

fox.taming_tip: Foxes are cunning. You must outsmart them.

bear_cub.taming_tip: ⚠️ DANGER: Mother bear may be nearby!

hawk.taming_tip: Hawks respect hunters. Prove yourself worthy.

rabbit.taming_tip: Easy to catch, but very fragile. Protect it!

snake.taming_tip: ⚠️ DANGER: Venomous! Failed tame = poison damage.

squirrel.taming_tip: Easy to befriend, but may steal from you!

bat.taming_tip: Approach quietly in darkness. Loud noises scare them.

maintenance_droid.taming_tip: Abandoned droids respond to gentle commands and spare parts.

scrap_spider.taming_tip: Built from salvage, they respect those who understand machinery.

wild_horse.taming_tip: Wild mustangs respect patience and confidence. Approach slowly, speak softly, and let them come to you.

coyote_pup.taming_tip: Coyote pups are curious but wary. Food and patience work best. Beware - the pack may hear its cries!

direwolf.taming_tip: CANNOT BE TAMED IN THE WILD. Quest reward only.

phoenix.taming_tip: The phoenix chooses its master. Cannot be tamed.

commons_assistance_notes: Only the chosen healthy following companion contributes. Positive help starts when bonded; loyalty is a care meter with no passive decay, stat penalties, fleeing or attacks by owned companions. Injured companions remain in the family and can recover through food or robot repair. Untamed adventure wildlife retains its configured approach dangers; Home wilds keep their gentle failure rules. Numeric species stats, legacy penalty fields and thresholds remain intact for compatibility. Hunting and taming help are Commons additions; other numeric skills retain the original species and robot recipe values.
